title: Moses Was Delayed
text: Now when the people saw that Moses was delayed in coming down from the mountain …

title: Make Us Gods
text: Come, make us gods who will go before us.

title: Gold Earrings
text: Take off the gold earrings that are on your wives and sons and daughters, and bring them to me.

title: They Brought Them
text: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.

title: Following the Crowd
text: Then all the people took off their gold earrings and brought them to Aaron.

title: A Molten Calf
text: … with an engraving tool he fashioned it into a molten calf.

title: These Are Your Gods
text: These, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt!

title: A Feast to the LORD
text: Tomorrow shall be a feast to the LORD.

title: They Have Corrupted Themselves
text: Go down at once, for your people … have corrupted themselves.

title: A Stiff-Necked People
text: I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

title: Moses Sought the LORD
text: But Moses sought the favor of the LORD his God …

title: Remember Abraham
text: Remember Your servants Abraham, Isaac, and Israel …

title: The LORD Relented
text: So the LORD relented from the calamity He had threatened to bring on His people.

title: The Work of God
text: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.

title: The Sound of Singing
text: It is neither the cry of victory nor the cry of defeat; I hear the sound of singing!

title: Shattered Tablets
text: … he burned with anger and threw the tablets out of his hands, shattering them at the base of the mountain.

title: Ground to Powder
text: Then he took the calf they had made, burned it in the fire, ground it to powder …

title: Out Came This Calf
text: And when I threw it into the fire, out came this calf!

title: A Great Sin
text: You have committed a great sin.

title: Blot Me Out
text: But if not, please blot me out of the book that You have written.

title: My Angel Shall Go before You
text: Now go, lead the people to the place I described. Behold, My angel shall go before you …

title: An Advocate
text: But if anyone does sin, we have an advocate before the Father—Jesus Christ, the Righteous One.

title: The Sound of War
text: The sound of war is in the camp.

title: Aaron and Hur
text: Aaron and Hur are here with you.

title: Stiff-Necked
text: I have seen this people, and they are indeed a stiff-necked people.

title: Revelry
text: And the people sat down to eat and drink and got up to indulge in revelry.
